# Bundled animation dependencies

These are pinned, unmodified browser distribution files. No CDN request is needed to run the site.

- Three.js 0.160.1: `three.min.js`, MIT license in `THREE-LICENSE.txt`. The global build supports directly opening the buildless archive. Its upstream deprecation notice is retained.
- GSAP 3.14.2 and ScrollTrigger 3.14.2: `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js`. Upstream copyright/license notices are retained at the top of both files. License reference: https://gsap.com/standard-license.

Retrieved from the corresponding versioned npm packages via jsDelivr. Optional animation failures leave the semantic content and CSS logo fallback available.
